text.card: A red giant 1,300 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.87 solar masses and 18.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,421 K at its surface.
